current_prompt.body: DETERMINE whether the given set L of 45 distinct positive integers can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that for each triple a_i + b_i = c_i. IF such a partition exists, PROVIDE one complete example of the partition, listing all 15 triples.

current_plan.body:
PARSE the input set L of 45 distinct positive integers
GENERATE all candidate triples (a, b, c) from L such that a + b = c
CONSTRUCT a representation linking numbers to candidate triples
SEARCH for a set of 15 disjoint triples that together cover every element of L
IF a covering set of 15 disjoint triples is found THEN EMIT the 15 triples as the partition
ELSE EMIT a statement that no such partition exists
